snapshot.method: Ten research files, each claim tied to pages fetched on 2026-11-10. Eight fact files were compiled from them, every claim was re-checked against its sources that day, and a red team attacked the twenty highest-stakes claims in each provider file and in the rankings. This file merges the eight. Unverified leads and rumors are in "unverified", never in a claim. The red-team passes for Google, Meta, xAI and the rankings finished on 2026-11-12: what they found dated after the snapshot is in "sinceSnapshot", and evidence they read late carries "readOn". The architecture and owner files were source-checked but not red-teamed.

stackLayers.sentence: A machine where the agent works, which keeps going when your laptop sleeps.

claim.text: He keeps shared notes for his agents in Notion, which every big AI app can connect to.

nodes.quote: GitHub for repos and skills

nodes.name: Skills, kept in GitHub

nodes.quote: I also have GitHub for the skills themselves, which is really impressive because a lot of people don't know that you can put the skills into GitHub like that.

claim.text: He keeps his agents' skills, saved instructions for one kind of job, in GitHub.

nodes.name: Infisical for API keys

nodes.quote: Infisical for API keys

claim.text: His API keys live in Infisical, a secrets manager. He calls it really important.

nodes.quote: My agents also file everything they generate into a second R2 storage space for me to review. It's about 386,000 files and 325 GB, which adds about $4.70 a month.

claim.text: His agents file everything they make into R2: about 386,000 files, 325 GB, $4.70 a month.

nodes.what: Serves his website, its database, video and AI search.
nodes.quote: Cloudflare hosts nearly all of it on its $5 a month plan, from the pages to the database, the video and the AI search.

claim.text: Cloudflare hosts nearly all of his site on a $5 a month plan.

arrows.quote: So no human talks with the coding agent.

arrows.quote: The lead agent, the one that starts and steers all the others

claim.text: He guesses Google's AI search may be best for web search.
